notes.title: Support Indie Game Development!
notes.notes:
Hello and thank you for purchasing Harmony!

As an indie game developer, support from anyone and everyone is critical. I truly appreciate your willingness to purchase the game, and feel bad that I have to ask for one more favor. You see, Steam pushes marketing for games like crazy once they reach 10 reviews. Harmony right now is at 8 reviews, only 2 away from that critical number! If you could please leave a review for Harmony (it doesn't have to be long), I will be forever grateful for your continued support.

Best,
-Carson
Aleph Null
